en.headline: Yau says misuse of another person's name on SIM cards will be criminalised
en.dek: The commerce secretary told lawmakers the government is also considering a lower cap on prepaid cards a person may register.
body: The government is preparing a new offence covering the improper registration of a SIM card in another person's name, Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau said on Wednesday.

In a written reply to the Legislative Council, Yau said the administration is reviewing the real-name registration system for SIM cards as part of work against telephone and online fraud. Planned measures include a lower cap on the number of prepaid cards an individual may register, and a new offence for using another person's name to register a card without lawful authority or reasonable excuse. He said the details were being prepared and the public would be consulted in due course.

Yau said operators had suspended an average of about 5,700 local numbers a month from January to August this year after suspicious calling or messaging patterns, down from about 11,400 a month in the same period last year. Since September 2022, operators and police had intercepted or suspended more than 120,000 web links and more than 17,000 local and non-local numbers by the end of August. Since April 2023, operators had blocked more than 8.9 million suspicious overseas calls that appeared to start with +852.

zh.headline: 丘應樺：擬將不當用他人名義登記電話卡刑事化
zh.dek: 商務及經濟發展局局長書面回覆立法會，指政府亦正考慮降低個人可登記儲值卡的數量上限。
body: 商務及經濟發展局局長丘應樺周三表示，政府正籌備新罪行，把在沒有合法權限或合理辯解下、不當使用他人名義登記電話智能卡的行為刑事化。
丘應樺書面回覆立法會議員質詢時說，為加強預防和打擊電訊網絡詐騙，當局正全面檢視電話智能卡實名登記制，並制訂更具針對性的措施，包括降低個人用戶可登記儲值卡的數量上限。他表示，政府正積極籌備修例細節，並會適時諮詢公眾。
丘應樺指出，電訊商若偵測到可疑通話或短訊模式，會暫停有關號碼。今年1月至8月，平均每月被暫停服務的本地號碼約5700個，較去年同期約11400個減少近半。自2022年9月起至今年8月底，電訊商與警方已攔截或暫停逾12萬個網頁連結及超過17000個本地及非本地號碼。自2023年4月起，電訊商亦已阻截超過890萬個以「+852」開首的可疑境外來電。
